about: A non-normative profile: SEDI's credentials in keripy 1.x's forms, and the incompatibilities between 1.x wallets that SEDI met (interop/two-wallets/RESULT.md), judged as keripy 1.x judges them. No specification defines the ACDC 1.x field set, its SAID or its vcp/iss/rev registry, so every assertion rests on the named implementation's behaviour (level INTEROP, with a basis) instead of a clause. It is sedi-1's companion, not part of it: a sedi-1x-interop result never enters a sedi-1 claim. This file is generated by scripts/regenerate from scenarios/sedi1x/ and must not be edited. Fields: name; normative (false); basis (the implementation and commit the expected values come from); cases (the case ids, in order).
name: sedi-1x-interop
